verdict: A clean, well-sourced, connected story in a style that holds up next to the house examples: dates and counts on screen (30 OKT 2026, PUTUSAN MA 742 K/TUN/2026, 120 · 8 FRAKSI, 96.214.691 labelled as the ticket's votes, 732 ANGGOTA MPR) match script.json, ILUSTRASI is on every frame, and the 40-41 s road travel back to the chair stage (turn_12nov.png) and the 732 seat-fill counter (slam_732.png) are the best craft moments. It does not clear the bar yet. The hook is a static headline beside a standing figure with no number and almost no motion in the first 0.27 s, so 0 s is only a moderate scroll-stopper for viewers not already following the news. The middle drags visually: five consecutive-frame pairs look alike, and 42-48 s is four samples of the same chair composition. Characters act very little (hook and end strips are near-identical frames), the 2023 whip is not visible, and small or clipped prop text ('SURAT PRESIDEN', 'SURAT MUNDUR', 'ANGGOTA MPR' over LO) plus a few stray cropped objects (plank at 24-26 s, red barrier fragment at 20-22 s, hairline at 12-16 s) look like errors. The last frame does land 'Lo nggak termasuk' with LO behind the MPR fence, but the orange-on-orange figure and duplicated headline blunt it. Audio is capped at 7 because nobody has listened. Fix the hook, break up 42-52 s and clear the prop-text and stray-object issues; those three would move the average above 8.
